info.name: Duka POS - Complete E2E User Journey
info.description:
End-to-end test collection covering the complete user journey: shop provisioning, verification, eTIMS, stock adjustment, sales, reports, staff auth, and auto-updates.

Flow order:
1. Health Check
2. Shop Provisioning (auth/link)
3. Verification (auth/verify)
4. Session Refresh (auth/refresh)
5. eTIMS Device Registration
6. eTIMS Receipt Issuance
7. eTIMS Status
8. eTIMS Z-Report
9. Stock Adjustment
10. Product Listing
11. Portfolio Reports
12. Staff Authentication
13. Update Manifest

Each request saves response data to collection variables for the next request.

exec: pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Body has status ok", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.status).to.eql("ok"); });
pm.test("Security header X-Content-Type-Options", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("X-Content-Type-Options")).to.eql("nosniff"); });
pm.test("Security header X-Frame-Options", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("X-Frame-Options")).to.eql("DENY"); });
pm.test("X-Request-ID header present", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("X-Request-ID")).to.not.be.null; });
pm.test("No X-Powered-By header", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("X-Powered-By")).to.be.undefined; });

request.description: Create tenant and owner profile, send verification code

exec: pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Has challenge_id", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("challenge_id"); pm.collectionVariables.set("challenge_id", d.challenge_id); });
pm.test("Email matches", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.email).to.eql("e2e@example.com"); });
pm.test("Expires in seconds is positive", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.expires_in_seconds).to.be.greaterThan(0); });
pm.test("Status is 409", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });
pm.test("Error mentions already linked", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.error).to.include("already linked"); });

request.description: Confirm verification code and mint session tokens

exec: pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Has access_token", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("access_token"); pm.collectionVariables.set("access_token", d.access_token); });
pm.test("Has refresh_token", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("refresh_token"); pm.collectionVariables.set("refresh_token", d.refresh_token); });
pm.test("Has tenant_id", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("tenant_id"); pm.collectionVariables.set("tenant_id", d.tenant_id); });
pm.test("Has shop_name", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("shop_name"); pm.collectionVariables.set("shop_name", d.shop_name); });
pm.test("Expires in seconds is 86400", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.expires_in_seconds).to.eql(86400); });
pm.test("Status is 400", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test("Error code is VERIFICATION_INVALID", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.code).to.eql("VERIFICATION_INVALID"); });

request.description: Exchange refresh token for new session

exec: pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Has new access_token", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("access_token"); pm.collectionVariables.set("access_token", d.access_token); });
pm.test("Has new refresh_token", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("refresh_token"); pm.collectionVariables.set("refresh_token", d.refresh_token); });
pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Has tin", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.tin).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("tin")); });
pm.test("Has device_id", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.device_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("device_id")); });
pm.test("Registered is true", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.registered).to.eql(true); });

request.description: Issue a KRA receipt for a committed sale

exec: pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test("Has kra_receipt_number", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.kra_receipt_number).to.match(/^KRA-/); pm.collectionVariables.set("kra_receipt_number", d.kra_receipt_number); });
pm.test("Has verification_url", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("verification_url"); });
pm.test("Has qr_payload", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("qr_payload"); });
pm.test("Status is ISSUED", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.status).to.eql("ISSUED"); });
pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test("Has configured field", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("configured"); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("pending_upload"); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("rejected"); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("device_status"); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("tin"); });

request.description: Get server-generated Z-report for a day

exec: pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Has date field", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.date).to.eql("2024-01-15"); });

pm.test("Has totals", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("totalSales"); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("totalProfit"); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("receiptCount"); pm.expect(d.sales).to.be.an("array"); });

request.description: Adjust stock for a single product immediately

exec: pm.test("Status is 200 or 404", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 404]); });

pm.test("If 200, has stock fields", function () { if (pm.response.code === 200) { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("product_id"); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("stockQty"); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("delta", 10); pm.collectionVariables.set("product_id", d.product_id); } });
pm.test("If 404, product not found error", function () { if (pm.response.code === 404) { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.error).to.eql("Product not found"); } });

request.description: List all products for the tenant

exec: pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Body is an array", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.be.an("array"); });

request.description: Get aggregated portfolio KPIs across linked tenants

exec: pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test("Has totals", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.totals).to.have.property("count"); pm.expect(d.totals).to.have.property("total"); pm.expect(d.totals).to.have.property("profit"); pm.expect(d.totals).to.have.property("byPaymentMethod"); pm.expect(d.sales).to.be.an("array"); });
pm.test("Has date range", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.from).to.contain("2024-01-01"); pm.expect(d.to).to.contain("2024-01-31"); });
pm.test("Status is 401", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test("Error message", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.error).to.eql("Staff not found or inactive"); });
pm.test("Status is 400", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test("Has version fields", function () { var d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("version_name"); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("version_code"); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("download_url"); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("required"); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("release_notes"); pm.expect(d.version_code).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(d.required).to.be.a("boolean"); });
